unlisted_practices: Reinforcement learning (GRPO/GDPO) with patient-specific, process-aware rewards derived from real-world clinical records to train an interactive LLM agent for colon cancer first-line treatment planning

screen.reason: The study develops and benchmarks an interactive reinforcement learning framework for LLM agent decision-making in colon cancer treatment planning using simulated environments derived from clinical records, without evaluating an organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
